mapper.sql: merchant_id, brand_id, category_code, merchant_code, merchant_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants (brand_id, category_code, merchant_code, merchant_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone) VALUES (#{brandId}, #{categoryCode}, #{merchantCode}, #{merchantName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchants ORDER BY merchant_id DESC

SELECT merchant_id, brand_id, category_code, merchant_code, merchant_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone, distance_meters FROM ( SELECT , 6371000 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(longitude) - RADIANS(#{lng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(latitude)) ) AS distance_meters FROM merchants ) AS merchants_with_distance WHERE distance_meters <= #{radiusMeters} ORDER BY distance_meters ASC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM merchants WHERE merchant_code = #{merchantCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET brand_id = #{brandId}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, merchant_code = #{merchantCode}, merchant_name = #{merchantName}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, phone = #{phone} WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
